title: Sub-bottom profiling shows the layers under the object

tellings.quote: sub-bottom profiling have we done. Mhm.

plain: In 2025 a team surveying the Baltic Sea anomaly, a strange object lying on the floor of the Baltic Sea, says it ran sub-bottom profiling, a sonar method that looks at the layers of mud and rock beneath the seabed. The treasure hunter Dennis Asberg, who found the object and took part in the survey, confirms to Michels that this was done. The results bear on his newer claim that the object sits apart from the seabed rather than being part of it.
